            - text: The best way to identify which phonics skills your child needs help with is to do a few short, playful reading activities and watch

          - paragraph: Phonics is the ability to connect letters with the sounds they represent and blend those sounds to read words. A child might recognize many letters but still struggle to blend them into words, for example.
